subject: Tenant seat rollout: admin rotations, API key seed & invite cadence
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@averytx.com>, Avery Tech Admins <eng@averytx.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tenant seat rollout: admin rotations, API key seed & invite cadence

Hi Liam / Avery team —

Thanks again for the kickoff today. Per our call, I wanted to put the initial plan in writing so we can lock dates and responsibilities. High level: we’ll provision the tenant, seed admin API keys for the integration team, and run a controlled invite cadence for 10 initial users (5 power users + 5 observers).

Quick asks from our side so we can schedule the provisioning sprint next week:
- Confirm the canonical project names (one project per service team). If you don’t have this list, we can start with temporary slugs and rename later.
- Confirm who will be the primary and secondary admins for the first 30 days (these accounts will get the seeded API keys and elevated roles).
- Any constraints on service account creation from your security/compliance team (ephemeral keys, rotation windows, external KMS use).

Attached: a CSV template for invite cadence and an inventory workbook for project namespaces. I’ll loop in Monica to propose a seed schedule.

Planned timeline (tentative):
- Day 0 (provision): create tenant + seed 2 admin API keys (primary + fallback)
- Day 1 (invite window 1): invite power users (5) + verify admin flows
- Day 3 (invite window 2): invite observers (5) + run API smoke tests
- Day 7: rotate fallback key and confirm audit logs with your team

If any of that is a non-starter let me know and we’ll adjust.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-invite-cadence-v1.csv, project-namespace-inventory.xlsx

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@averytx.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Avery Tech Admins <eng@averytx.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant seat rollout: admin rotations, API key seed & invite cadence

Vanessa — thanks, this looks good. Quick answers inline:

- Project names: we have three service teams (ingest, inference-api, ui-frontend). Can you pre-create namespaces using those slugs?
- Admins: Primary = liam.oconnor@averytx.com, Secondary = ops+oncall@averytx.com (group). Secondary is a distribution list; hope that’s ok for the fallback admin.
- Security: we require HSM-backed KMS for any long-lived keys. Short-lived (<=48h) ephemeral keys are fine. We will need a key rotation audit log within 7 days after provisioning.

Also, can you confirm rate-limits & quota plan for the seeded admin keys? We plan to run a low-volume smoke test then scale.

—Liam
Avery Therapeutics — Platform Engineering

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@averytx.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-31T08:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant seat rollout: admin rotations, API key seed & invite cadence

Thanks Liam — that distribution list fallback is fine; we'll document it as a group-managed fallback admin (we'll request an owner). Two operational notes:

1) API key plan: for provisioning sprint we will seed:
   - admin-primary (long-lived, HSM-backed; stored in your KMS)
   - admin-fallback (short-lived with 48h rotation window; Redwood will rotate unless you request ownership)
   - svc-inference (service account key scoped to inference endpoints; ephemeral default ttl = 24h)

2) Invite cadence: we recommend the CSV mapped to roles: PowerUser, Observer, BillingContact. We will invite PowerUsers first and gate the Observer wave on completed smoke tests.

Open question for Redwood: do we want to create an initial service-account with role "tenant-admin:monitor" for your SREs, or keep service accounts scoped to inference-api only?

I’ll propose the actual invite dates once Vanessa confirms your calendar availability.

Best,
Monica
Senior Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@averytx.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant seat rollout: admin rotations, API key seed & invite cadence

Hi all — small checklist & proposed defaults from the infra side so we don't get blocked:

- Namespace creation: Redwood will create namespaces: avery-ingest, avery-inference, avery-ui. We will keep project IDs readable (no random suffix) for the first 30 days, then append stable ids if needed.
- Admin keys:
  * admin-primary: HSM-backed long-lived (we will emit a key fingerprint and the provisioning manifest).
  * admin-fallback: rotated every 48h by default; can be handed off to customer-managed KMS after life 7 days.
- Quotas: default seeded quota = 5 qps, burst 20 for the seeded admin keys. If Avery wants a higher quota for smoke tests, we can temporarily bump to 20 qps for the first 24 hours. Please confirm whether you want the temporary bump.
- Service accounts: we recommend a dedicated svc-inference role with read-only metrics and write inference permission; do not use tenant-admin for service automation.

Operational handoff: once admin keys are seeded we will generate a single-page provisioning manifest and a rotation schedule. Vanessa / Monica — can you own the manifest distribution to Avery and confirm the owner for ops+oncall?

Cheers,
Jonas
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@averytx.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant seat rollout: admin rotations, API key seed & invite cadence

Thanks team — wrapping up action items and next steps:

1) Avery to confirm: temporary quota bump to 20 qps for Day 0 smoke test (Liam) — please reply by EOD 6/3.
2) Redwood action: create namespaces (avery-ingest, avery-inference, avery-ui) and seed keys (admin-primary HSM, admin-fallback 48h rotation, svc-inference ephemeral). Target provisioning window: 2026-06-07 09:00 PT.
3) Monica will send the invite CSV with exact invite timestamps (wave 1 = power users, wave 2 = observers).
4) Jonas will produce the provisioning manifest and rotation schedule and link it into the Drive doc (link above).
5) Avery to provide the owner for ops+oncall distribution list (we need an owner for fallback admin access).

Attachments re-sent: redwood-invite-cadence-v1.csv, project-namespace-inventory.xlsx

If there are any blockers to the 6/7 provisioning window we will move to the week of 6/14; please call out conflicts in your reply.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
